newsitem.title: USA: Wells-Gardner gets $10.4 mln in Jan orders.
newsitem.headline: Wells-Gardner gets $10.4 mln in Jan orders.

text.p: Wells-Gardner Electronics Corp said Tuesday it received $10.4 million in of new orders in January.
That by far marks the largest order month since the company began keeping such records, with the next largest being $5.2 million in May 1995, the open-frame monitor manufacturer said.
"We cannot expect this order level every month but this is a great start to 1997," chief executive officer Tony Spier said in a news release.
One order for an Internet product totalled $5.8 million, the company said.
Wells-Gardner shares were unchanged at 3-7/8 Tuesday.
